summary:
Main
Iron ore futures consolidated on a strong note today. The most-traded DCE I2701 contract closed at 726.5 yuan/mt, up 0.14% fromthe previous trading day. Spot prices at Qingdao Port rose by 1-2 yuan/mt overall, with steel mills mostly purchasing as needed.
